caption: Viral video shows dog trying to leave vet appointment.
A viral video shared by the popular WeRateDogs account shows a massive dog named Frank deciding his vet appointment was over before the staff agreed.

In the clip, Frank suddenly stands up while a veterinary technician is still leaning on his back and casually attempts to walk out of the examination room as if he’s completely done with the visit. The hilarious moment quickly exploded online, with many viewers joking that Frank “had places to be.”
The footage has gained millions of views across social media, with users praising the dog’s calm attitude and the technician’s reaction as she tried to stay balanced while Frank walked away.
